checks.details: Icarus 12 compile and simulation succeeded; 5126 cycles checked with independent per-bit recurrence, reset timing, reset priority, restart, and falling-edge stability.

limitations: Development verification is not official evaluation.
Finite seeded simulation does not exhaust the entire 32-bit state space.
Original specification gives no required power-up numeric state; verification begins numeric recurrence checks after synchronous reset.
